feature: A --ci check that checked nothing does not pass
description: `hexa adr gates --ci` and `hexa spec verify --ci` exit non-zero, with a reason, when the run judged no gate or found no scenario. Everything else behaves as before.

specs.description: gates --ci in a repository with no ADR fails and says nothing was checked
specs.given: a repository whose docs/adrs/ holds no ADR
specs.then: it exits non-zero, and its output says that no ADR records a gate, so nothing was checked

specs.description: gates --ci where every ADR is without a gate fails
specs.given: a repository with three ADRs, none of which records a gate
specs.then: it exits non-zero, and its output says that no ADR records a gate, so nothing was checked

specs.description: one passing gate is not an empty run
specs.given: a repository with one ADR whose gate passes and two ADRs without a gate, none declared unbuilt
specs.then: it exits 0, and its output does not say that nothing was checked

specs.description: a gate declared unbuilt was judged, so the run is not empty
specs.given: a repository with one ADR whose gate fails and is declared in adr.unbuilt with a reason, and other ADRs without a gate
specs.then: its output does not say that nothing was checked; the run is judged as ADR-2610271110 decides for declared ADRs

specs.description: one failing gate fails for that gate, not for an empty run
specs.given: a repository with one ADR whose gate fails and others without a gate
specs.then: it exits non-zero, reports the failed gate, and its output does not say that nothing was checked

specs.description: gates --ci reports an empty run exactly when no gate was judged
specs.given: any set of ADRs, each with any outcome (passed, failed, unrunnable, cannot-run-here, not-proven-here, no gate) and any adr.unbuilt declaration
specs.then: the output says nothing was checked exactly when no ADR's verdict is passed, failed or declared unbuilt, and every such run exits non-zero

specs.description: verify --ci with no spec fails and says nothing was checked
specs.given: a repository with no file in docs/specs/
specs.then: it exits non-zero, and its output says that no spec holds a scenario, so nothing was checked

specs.description: verify --ci where specs hold no scenarios fails
specs.given: a repository with two specs whose `specs` lists are empty
specs.then: it exits non-zero, and its output says that no spec holds a scenario, so nothing was checked

specs.description: a run with only pending scenarios is not the empty case
specs.given: a repository whose only spec holds scenarios that are all pending, for an ADR that is not Completed
specs.then: its output reports the pending scenarios as it does today and does not say that nothing was checked, and it exits as it does today

specs.description: one passing scenario is not an empty run
specs.given: a repository with one spec holding one sealed scenario whose test passes
specs.then: it exits 0, and its output does not say that nothing was checked

specs.description: verify --ci reports an empty run exactly when there is no scenario
specs.given: any set of specs, each holding any number of scenarios in any state (passed, failed, not proven here, pending)
specs.then: the output says nothing was checked, and the run exits non-zero for that reason, exactly when the total number of scenarios across all specs is zero

specs.description: without --ci an empty repository is reported as today
specs.given: a repository with no ADR and no spec
specs.when: `hexa adr gates` and `hexa spec verify` run without --ci
specs.then: each prints its zero-count summary as today, neither says that nothing was checked, and each exits 0

specs.description: verify for one ADR is judged as before
specs.given: a spec for ADR X with no scenarios
specs.then: it is judged as it was before this ADR, and its output does not say that no spec holds a scenario

specs.description: the new guard must not turn a passing non-empty --ci run into a failure
specs.given: a repository with one ADR whose gate passes and one spec with one scenario whose test passes
specs.when: `hexa adr gates --ci` and `hexa spec verify --ci` run
specs.then: both exit 0 with the same summary they printed before this ADR

specs.description: without --ci, no gate recorded does not fail
specs.given: a repository with ADRs, none of which records a gate
specs.then: it exits 0 and does not say that nothing was checked

specs.description: outside the empty --ci case, output and exit status are unchanged
specs.given: any repository and any invocation that is not a --ci run of `hexa adr gates` judging no gate and is not a --ci run of `hexa spec verify` finding no scenario
specs.then: its exit status and summary are the same as they were before this ADR

amendments.reason: Fixture defects only: S10's project had no test home, so spec accept refused it before the run under test (a pyproject.toml now gives one, and its .sh test keeps the built-in bash runner); S14's spec had one example and no negative for §1, so verify rejected the spec as incomplete (a negative scenario is added; its summary assertion counts the two scenarios, 2 passed, the same check as before for the complete spec). Without the fix S10 and S14 pass: guards, recorded red only for these defects
